_comment: 相談の 練習の「話しかける タイミング」（要望 #723）。hendy の 席の 絵 4枚: 大丈夫そう（しごとは して いる）・電話中・いそがしそう（あせって いる）・ほかの 人と 話して いる。1枚目（大丈夫そう）が 絵柄アンカーに なり、残り 3枚は 机・小物・構図を そろえて 動きと 表情だけ 変える。looks は 立ち絵の 台帳から 逐語。背景ごと 撮る（切りぬかない）。 2026-11-13: 電話中の 絵で 片方の 腕から 手が 2つ 出て いた（tomy さんの 指摘・要望 #734）。左手で 電話・右手で 書く と 腕と 手の 数を 明記して 作り直した。
style: Style: clean modern Japanese manga / anime style, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows, warm daylight, contemporary Japan, kid-safe e-learning illustration. EMOTIONS ARE BIG AND OBVIOUS, like a Japanese comedy manga.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image: computer screens show only abstract coloured blocks and lines, papers and sticky notes are blank. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border.
negative: Never: realistic photo rendering, harsh gradients, six fingers, extra limbs, readable letters, dark horror tone, angry faces, real sadness or tears, costume changes between the four pictures, a drawn checkerboard pattern, a second copy of the main character.

scenes.title: 大丈夫そう（しごとは して いる）
scenes.scene:
Character: 先輩エンジニア（ネクストメイク4年目のプロジェクトマネージャ兼プログラマー。外国から来て日本語をゼロから覚えた当事者で、学習者にとって『先に同じ道を歩いた人』） — Japanese-style anime character, man in his late twenties, slim build, about 175cm, relaxed upright posture. Short black hair, slightly tousled with soft spiky tips and a loose fringe. Dark brown eyes, straight thick eyebrows, clean-shaven, gentle smile. Business suit: navy single-breasted two-button jacket (#2A3550) worn open or buttoned, crisp white dress shirt, solid navy necktie (#233A63), matching navy slacks (#2E3A57), black leather belt, black leather lace-up oxford shoes. No lanyard, no bag, no glasses.
Setting: the bright small software team office in Japan from the office reference picture (morning light from the windows on the left, whiteboard, potted plants). He sits on an office chair at his own desk. On the desk: a laptop and one external monitor, a small desk calendar with blank squares, a coffee mug. Camera: eye level, from slightly front-left, a medium shot showing him from the waist up and the whole desk top; he is in the centre of the picture with some office visible around him. This first picture sets the desk, props and framing for the next three pictures.
State: calmly working — it would be fine to talk to him now. He types on the laptop at an easy pace, shoulders relaxed, sitting upright, a calm focused face with a small gentle smile, looking at the screen. The desk is tidy. He is clearly working, but not in a hurry. The expression and body language must read clearly at a glance even when the picture is small.
